summary: LDO AMS1117-3.3 5.00 V → 3.30 V at 500 mA: 905 mW in the regulator, efficiency 64.6 %, T_J ≈ 106 °C (within T_J max 125 °C); dropout ok.

dropout.conditions: ΔV_OUT = 1 %, I_OUT = 0.8 A; specified up to 0.8 A (Note 4)

result.formula: P = (V_in − V_out) · I_load + V_in · I_q; T_J = T_A + P · θ_JA; η = V_out · I_load / (V_in · (I_load + I_q))

assumptions.reason: T_J follows the average power; check the dropout and the current limit with the peak current (rule of thumb)
room temperature; inside a case it is warmer
